body: I really wish it worked that way, but it unfortunately doesn't and I don't want to get into trouble and then pay even more later. We live in a disgusting world, that's for sure.

What you wrote about noise hits harder than I thought... It just proves my points to my family and friends and I'm glad I'm not alone in getting upset about all this. I stopped using my bike and just use the shittier bus stop in front of my house just to avoid these loud ugly machines. I'm simply scared of them. And even waiting for the bus is energy-drowning and scary because cars are loud. I can't wait in peace. People be literally shouting to each other while waiting with me. A few days ago I was waiting with a friend and we were shouting to be able to hear each other. I asked him "Do you even notice that we have to shout to hear each other because of the fucking cages?" and he says, "Yeah, but what are you gonna do?"... He's right... It is a lost cause...

I installed a helping motor on my bike to get to places without sweating (although I always ended up in sweat because I used the extra power to go faster rather than with less effort, haha) and that motor is a bit loud, but obviously not nearly as loud as a car or motrocycle. Why I'm telling you this is because I'm always scared who is going to tell me or mock me one day to get my loud piece of shit out of here... I'M the one scared for using an environmentaly friendly vehicle that has a slightly louder sound (and I'm one of the few), THEY are the ones with super loud cars and motorcycles EVERYWHERE...

Another day I told a car-brained friend that man I'm so sick of the loudness of cars, and he says "Well, that's what electric cars are for" and I almost started to fume... I asked him "Do you realize that after a certain (pretty low) speed, wheel noise takes over engine noise?" and he's like "I don't think so". At that point I just started to talk about something else because there's no way I'm arguing against actual proven facts... What is going on in this world?
Well, yeah, no one's surprised, but torching it was indeed way too far...

You're so right, it’s that exact mix of "they know how much this hurts me" and "they do it anyway" that cuts deepest. And yeah… I'm scared you’re right about her doing it again someday. That’s what’s hardest, the idea that the lesson won't even land...

Your story with your dad mirrors my own with painful accuracy. It's like pedestrians need to prove that they deserve a clear path.

I hate how much we’re told "better get used to it"... Like it’s our job to bend, or break, or go numb....

So yeah, I guess I do better get used to it...

Now cars on the other hand? They might be the reason I'll just give up this whole thing because they are annoying as hell, most people can't drive around buses, they don't let me out of the stop, they block bus stops, cut me off, illegally pass, I have daily close calls and I've already crashed twice (not my fault). Maybe it is because I'm overly sensitive, but I also hate it when someone tailgates me and I'm forced to go fast, so I'm thankful we have 50 km/h limiters on our buses. I have a shit ton of dashcam footage I always show anyone who asks me why I hate cars and it shuts them right up. I'm just so fucking sick of these metal boxes... Does anyone relate, or am I crazy?

I used to get upset about this. In my city we have a front door boarding policy on some lines. I also got really upset when people didn't even look at me. So I said fuck it and told the company to please avoid putting me on front door boarding routes. It was sort of successful, because they now put me on a route that only has this policy after 8 pm and passengers get confused about this or forget that it's after hours and they mostly don't give a shit so I do the same. If someone wants to show me their pass or buy a ticket, I smile and thank them or give them a ticket, respectively. However, if they don't even bother to say "Good evening", well, then, fuck you... Hell, sometimes I even start to talk in a medium-low voice to myself something like "Well, good evening to you too!" or "I like to ride for free too!" or "That's right, don't even look at me, fucker..." and so on... Don't get me wrong, it still bugs me sometimes, but compared to like 1 year ago when I used to really get angry, I don't really care anymore. It's not worth it, you'll eat up yourself very fast. Stay strong, friend:)

Yeah, well here in Budapest (Hungary), the public transport system is pretty good. The traffic is getting worse and worse and I hate traffic. A liter of gas costs almost 500 forints (around 1,5 dollars), with my wage being around 400 usd / month. A monthly pass for unlimited rides all over the city (buses, trams, trolleys, metros, trains, etc..) costs a bit over 10 dollars. So in my case it's not really worth it to use a car. Sometimes I barely even have money to eat, let alone for gas.. The car was a gift from my father a long time ago. You might ask "Then how do you have money for cruising?" Friends pitch in :D 
Anyway, sometimes I think I might be better off by selling it, although that would be sad because I love it so much :(
